extracted.intended_audience: attorneys/agents seeking reinstatement to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office; Office of Enrollment and Discipline staff
extracted.subtask_description: Administrative decision on a petition for reinstatement to practice before the USPTO, based on the filed petition, supporting affidavit under 37 CFR § 11.58, and any public responses to a published notice. Records the Director's determination to grant or deny reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Petition for Reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: Consideration has been given to the Petition for Reinstatement of Phillip M. Pippenger received on October 10, 2014.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A formal Petition for Reinstatement must be filed and will be considered by the Office; the petition's filing date is recorded and is the starting point for review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affidavit pursuant to 37 CFR § 11.58
rubrics_metrics.description: Mr. Pippenger has filed an Affidavit pursuant to 37 CFR § 11.58 in support of the Petition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A supporting affidavit that complies with 37 CFR § 11.58 is required to support a reinstatement petition; such an affidavit is a central piece of evidence the Office reviews when deciding reinstatement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice publication and consideration of responses
rubrics_metrics.description: After careful review of the Petition, the supporting affidavit, and any information that was received in response to the publication of a Notice of Petition for Reinstatement, the Director ... has determined ...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Office publishes a Notice of Petition for Reinstatement and will consider any information or responses submitted in reaction to that notice as part of the reinstatement evaluation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Director's determination of appropriateness for reinstatement
rubrics_metrics.description: The Director of the Office of Enrollment and Discipline has determined that reinstatement of Mr. Pippenger to practice before the United States Patent and Trademark Office is appropriate. Accordingly, the Petition is hereby GRANTED.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The final decision rests with the Director (Office of Enrollment and Discipline) based on review of the petition, the required affidavit, and any public responses; the Director may grant reinstatement when, in their judgment, reinstatement is appropriate.
